question: What is the air quality in Central Singapore right now?
name: ChatGPT
answer:
Central Singapore’s **24-hour PSI is 165 — Unhealthy**, according to the latest reading I found, checked about five minutes ago. ([anything.com.sg](https://www.anything.com.sg/psi/))

If you’re sensitive to haze or have heart or lung conditions, consider limiting prolonged outdoor exertion. NEA also reports air quality by **1-hour PM₂.₅**, which reflects more immediate conditions. ([nea.gov.sg](https://www.nea.gov.sg/our-services/pollution-control/air-pollution/faqs?trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block&utm_source=openai))
